title: Plasmid Construction and Viral Infection Protocol
author: Yuejun Wang
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.iehcbb6
materials: MSCs were plated overnight, then infected with retroviruses in the presence of polybrene (6 µg/mL, Sigma-Aldrich, St. Louis, MO, USA) for 12 h.

steps.title: Produce Flag-IGFBP2 cDNA
steps.instruction: Produce human full-length IGFBP2 cDNA from ASCs fused to a M2-Flag tag using a standard PCR protocol.

steps.title: Subclone Sequence into Vector
steps.instruction: Subclone the Flag-IGFBP2 sequence into the pQCXIN retroviral vector using AgeI and BglII restriction sites.

steps.title: Verify Plasmid Sequences
steps.instruction: Verify all constructed plasmid sequences via appropriate restriction digestion and/or sequencing.

steps.title: Select Infected Cells
steps.instruction: Select infected cells 48 hours after infection using 600 µg/mL G418 for a duration of 10 days.
